Description.Name: Ray Headley
Description.Details: Ray Headley, or "Jockstrap", had it all - the fame, the fortune, and the love of the crowd. He's best known as the Star Gladiator for the Golden Suns, a Solaris team with an impressively high record of coring out 'Mech engines. He unceremoniously earned his nickname when, during a match against an opposing team of Urbanmechs, a bump on the cockpit of his Firestarter dislodged the MechWarrior from his seat right into his good-luck trophy. The object slammed between him and the cockpit, opening mic channels and breaking his communications relay as he yelled out to world those infamous words: "...Thank God I remembered my Jockstrap!"
